verdict.rationale: Isaac Sim stores scenes and robots in OpenUSD, an open format, and the GitHub repo lists asset import and export to and from non-USD formats. Isaac Lab is open source and GR00T N1 is Apache-2 licensed, which reduces lock-in. However, nothing documents a complete export of all user data (synthetic datasets, trained policies, configurations), and the export formats and their fidelity are not specified. Missing for 10: documented full-data export covering datasets, policies and configs; named open export formats (e.g. URDF/MJCF round-trip); independent or hands-on confirmation that migrating off the platform works.
